exposure: ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) treatment for intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP)
severity of ICP (total bile acid levels)
total bile acid levels at diagnosis (<40 µmol/L, ≥40 µmol/L)
outcome: perinatal outcome (Apgar scores, umbilical artery pH)
finding: UDCA treatment for ICP was well-tolerated and associated with good obstetric outcomes, although Apgar scores at 5 minutes were lower in the UDCA group.
